notes.Prev_Bal: The 'Resumen de Saldo' box has two similarly-labeled rows: 'Saldo anterior $88.03' (the balance carried in before this cycle's payment) and 'Saldo anterior pendiente $0.00' (the remainder after the $88.03 payment was applied). Prev_Bal uses the first ($88.03), matching the other two documents' convention of 'balance before this cycle's payment'. LLM's value (0.00) is the post-payment figure, mislabeled.
notes.Tot_Amt/Total_Current_Charges: 'Total de cargos actuales' ($110.19) plus 'Saldo anterior pendiente' ($0.00) doesn't reconcile to the prominently repeated 'Total a pagar' ($86.47, shown 3 times) - the same kind of internal arithmetic inconsistency seen on the Spanish-language electric bill in this test set. Both values are recorded as printed rather than reconciled.
notes.is_total_amount_greater_than_equal_to_cu: Tot_Amt ($86.47) < Total_Current_Charges ($110.19), so this is false/No - both extractors' individual field values are correct here, and LLM's 'No' answer for this check is also correct.
notes.Dates: Printed as MM/DD/YYYY ('07/21/2026', etc.); normalized to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) here, consistent with every other date field in this schema. This is an AWS-managed blueprint (water-and-sewer-bill) whose field descriptions instruct MM/DD/YYYY - not ours to edit - but since these are single-value (not list) date fields, extraction-compare's normalizer resolves BDA's MM/DD/YYYY to the same calendar date, which now counts as an exact match.
